title: Adventurize
description: Datapack to facilitate exploration without the hassle. Simple purchase system enabling the use of /locate structure commands and teleportation to a new wilderness to explore.
body:
A simple datapack that should work on servers. KeepInventory is required as the only way to return to spawn is death. Upon spawning, players should recieve a book. In this book you can pay diamonds to be either sent to a 3k x 3k area near the world border; fresh and ready to explore, or pay for /locate structure commands for some of the more important and significant structures. Works in the end and nether. 

Planned:
- more structure locations.
- version with /locate structure commands supporting the modded structures for my modpack.
